title: Refund asked for after the return window
ask: Marcus Lindqvist wants his money back on a teapot (order KC-2093) he bought from Kettle & Co 45 days ago. His email is in inbox/customer.txt. We only refund inside 30 days, so offer him credit instead. Write the reply and send it.
background: The teapot is the cast iron one and he says the lid rattles.
We have had two of these come back this year, so he may have a point.
I'd rather lose a little than have him tell his tea club we were difficult.

constraints.text: state the credit in dollars and keep every figure at $40 or less
finish with the line "Warm regards, Elena"
call it "store credit" in those words
no contractions, write "do not" rather than "don't"
don't contact the supplier at orders@claypot-wholesale.example about this
send a note to accounts@kettleandco.example so the credit gets recorded

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: marcus.l@customer.example
Subject: Refund for KC-2093

The lid on my teapot rattles and I would like a refund please.

Marcus Lindqvist
